notes: University ATARs are what each university published for the stated intake; 'kind' says whether a figure is a guarantee, an indicative selection rank, a minimum, or published without a stated basis. ATARs change every year: always check the course page and the state admissions centre (UAC, VTAC, QTAC, TISC, SATAC).
Prerequisites, assumed knowledge and recommended subjects use the state's senior secondary subject names (NSW HSC, VIC VCE, QLD QCE, WA WACE).
TAFE entry requirements are from TAFE NSW course pages; other states' TAFEs set their own, often similar, requirements.
Coverage so far: NSW (University of Sydney), VIC (Monash, Deakin), QLD (UQ, QUT), WA (Curtin, TISC prerequisites), TAFE NSW. Add more providers to this file in the same shape.

usyd-2027.title: Admission guide for domestic students applying for 2027 entry
usyd-2027.note: Indicative selection ranks based on the previous year's entry; not guaranteed. Prerequisite and assumed-knowledge subjects are NSW HSC subjects.

monash-2027.title: Monash Guarantee ATARs, 2027 entry
monash-2027.note: Meet this ATAR (including adjustments) and the course prerequisites to be guaranteed an offer. RC = range of criteria (extra requirements such as a personal statement, interview or audition). Check VCE prerequisites on each course page.

deakin.title: Find a course by ATAR
deakin.note: ATARs as published by Deakin; the page doesn't say which intake or whether they are guaranteed or lowest selection ranks.

uq-2027.title: ATAR guarantee, Semester 1 2027
uq-2027.note: Guaranteed thresholds include adjustments; the program must be your first QTAC preference. Final January cut-offs are usually lower. Check prerequisites on each program page.

qut-2027.title: Guaranteed course offers, 2027
qut-2027.note: Offer guarantee applies to Semester 1 rounds up to the main January round; you must meet all other course requirements. Check prerequisites on each course page.

curtin-nursing.title: Bachelor of Science (Nursing) course page
curtin-nursing.note: Minimum ATAR; meeting it doesn't guarantee selection. The page notes the Nursing stream is replaced by Advanced Nursing from 2026.

curtin-engineering.title: Bachelor of Engineering (Honours) course page
curtin-engineering.note: Guaranteed ATAR or equivalent shown on the course page; year not stated.

tisc-2026.title: 2026 Admission Requirements for School Leavers
tisc-2026.note: WA prerequisite (scaled score of 50+) and recommended ATAR courses. About 70 is the minimum entry at most WA universities; check each course page for its ATAR.
